finding.title: Replace raw English string literals with AppLocalizations across onboarding screens, steps, and validators

evidence.quote: 'You must leave at least some content unmarked to continue learning.',
'You can set up rewards later in Parent Mode',
'Set a 4-digit PIN to access parent controls for $childName. '
? 'A profile with this name already exists'
return 'Password must be at least 6 characters';

finding.why: Hebrew-locale users (this app's RTL-supported primary non-English audience) hit untranslated English text through nearly every screen of the core onboarding flow: all 6 onboarding_screen.dart AppBar titles, the entire Parent-PIN setup screen (6 strings, file has no AppLocalizations import at all), 4 of 5 strings on the child hand-off screen, both add-another-track strings, 5 strings in the bulk-mark confirmation/search/done flow, ~19 strings across the learning-process wizard (wizard_steps.dart) including a literal mixed-language bug where Mon/Tue/Wed/Thu/Fri/Sun render in English but Shabbos correctly renders via terms.shabbos in the same label, the duplicated profile-name-exists error, and 3 signup/sign-in form validators whose return values render directly as TextFormField errorText. test/features/onboarding/presentation/steps/wizard_steps_l1_test.dart pins several of these literal strings directly (find.text('Follow a program'), find.text('How do you review?')), so the existing test suite locks in the bug instead of catching it.
finding.recommendation: Extract every literal into ARB keys mirroring the correct usages already present in the same files (e.g. l10n.startLearning), add ICU plurals for count-driven strings (trackCount, delayDays, _selections.length), replace the hardcoded day-abbreviation maps with a helper backed by AppLocalizations/DateFormat.EEEE so all 7 days localize uniformly, and update wizard_steps_l1_test.dart/related tests to assert on localized output instead of literal English text.
acceptance_criteria: make arb-parity stays green after new keys are added

a Rule-0 grep/lint added under lib/features/onboarding/presentation/** fails when a raw string literal (not an AppLocalizations getter) is passed to Text()/errorText/hintText/label — the AX-2 [P] literals checker this backlog needs
wizard_steps_l1_test.dart assertions changed from find.text('Follow a program') to locale-driven lookups so a regression re-breaks the test
manual/e2e pass with Locale('he') through onboarding shows no Latin-script UI copy and no mixed-language day labels
